title: Tenma Saki — Feeling Like An Incognito Idol〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: One Small Trip Before a Big Journey

rows.Line: Red Brick Center - Building 1, 1st Floor

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sorry for the wait, you two! Everything looked so yummy I had trouble choosing.

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: I totally get it! Every souvenir just had this weird charm to it.

rows.Speaker: Sonoda
rows.Line: Mhm. There were even some that were store exclusive and seasonal too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: By the way, where's Ichi and Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: I think they're still picking out souvenirs, right? They didn't send a message saying they were waiting, so...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I know that Ichi was having trouble deciding what to get Miku and the others, so maybe that's what's taking time?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Haruka also said that she was picking out souvenirs for Airi and the others too...)
Sorry! Thanks for waiting!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? Wasn't Haruka with you?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! She got recognized?!

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: Saki, shhh! Shhh!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: S-So Haruka is giving all of those elementary school kids handshakes?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah... She said she'll meet us when she's done.

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: Wow, Kiritani really is popular among people of all ages.

rows.Speaker: Sonoda
rows.Line: Now's not the time for that. She got recognized through her disguise, you know?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm, but Haruka's idol aura is on like a whole other level. So some glasses probably weren't enough...

rows.Speaker: Sonoda
rows.Line: I hope she's okay...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: All of those kids listened to her request, so I don't think they'll cause a huge ruckus...

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: But we'll be doing more sightseeing after this... It might be risky.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If loads of people end up gathering around her, then Haruka won't be able to enjoy the field trip.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If she got recognized with her current disguise, why don't we just come up with another one?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I mean, there's lots of clothing stores here. Let's go find some stuff for her new disguise!

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: Good idea! That might work!

rows.Speaker: Sonoda
rows.Line: Agreed! I think I saw a shop that sold some hats and glasses!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright! Let's go find some stuff and come up with a new disguise!
2nd Floor

rows.Speaker: Sonoda
rows.Line: Oh, there it is! The hat and glasses shop!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oooh! There's a lot of trendy stuff!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm sure we'll find something that would suit Kiritani.

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: Hehe. Should we have a competition to see who picked out the best item?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You're on! I'm totally gonna win!

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: Oh, what about these? The color of the lenses is pretty dark. Wouldn't these be the perfect sunglasses for a disguise?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oooh, you're right! They would totally hide your eyes.

rows.Speaker: Sonoda
rows.Line: Hey, there's another pair of glasses that are similar, but the lenses are bigger!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. Aren't you two a little too focused on glasses?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ta-da! A chic hat! Wouldn't this cover her face just nicely?

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line:
Oooh! It is chic!
So what would this look like together with the sunglasses?

rows.Speaker: Sonoda
rows.Line: Can you try them on, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sure thing♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: How do I look?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um... You look exactly like a celebrity in disguise.

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: Oof. That's the opposite of what we want...

rows.Speaker: Sonoda
rows.Line: I think we should change the glasses. I'll have a look a little further inside the shop!

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: Oh, me too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey Ichi, let's have a look for some other stuff that might suit Haruka♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sounds good.
